candidates.label: A - Quiet charcoal / enclosed draft
candidates.difference: Small enclosed carbon fire, restrained dry crackle beneath a soft air draw.
candidates.prompt: A small enclosed charcoal fire steadily heats a primitive ceramic chamber. Quiet dry ember crackle and a soft natural air draw through a narrow opening, close and contained, no large flames. Even low-fatigue working texture, seamless three-second repeat, no start or stop. No electric hum, tonal drone, machinery motor, music, voices, beeps, alarms or cinematic rumble.

candidates.label: B - Damped embers / softer draft
candidates.difference: Same combustion role with finer, less bright crackle and a gentler breath of air.
candidates.prompt: Close, subdued embers burning steadily inside a small brick and ceramic firebox. Fine muted fuel crackle under a gentle breath of naturally drawn air; smaller and softer than a campfire. Uniform unobtrusive texture, seamless three-second repeat, no ignition or shutdown. No electric hum, sustained musical tone, motor, music, voice, alarm, metallic impacts or dramatic fire roar.

candidates.label: A - Narrow clay-channel flow
candidates.difference: Small continuous water movement and restrained fine sediment, no thick paddle friction.
candidates.prompt: A small steady stream of water moves through a narrow clay channel and across fine mineral sediment. Close soft trickling, delicate low gurgles and tiny wet grains; restrained and compact, not a river. Even low-fatigue working texture, seamless three-second repeat, no start or stop. No paddle, electric motor, hum, tonal drone, music, voices, large splashes, bubbling tank or cinematic effects.

candidates.label: B - Softer contained water draw
candidates.difference: Same small moving-water role with smoother draw and fewer bright droplets.
candidates.prompt: Quiet contained water movement in a small primitive clay water-transfer channel. A gentle continuous draw with soft liquid folds, occasional tiny gurgles and muted droplets over fine sediment. Close, smooth and low fatigue, seamless three-second working repeat, no start or stop. No motor, grinding stone, paddle, electronic hum, music, voice, large splashes, boiling or dramatic rushing.

candidates.label: A - Compact mineral scrape
candidates.difference: Restrained mineral-working head and granular extraction, not a quern disc or electric engine.
candidates.prompt: A compact primitive mineral-extraction head steadily scrapes and loosens coarse stone. Restrained irregular mechanical rasp, dry grit falling and small dull contact knocks; close and contained, no large drill engine. Even low-fatigue working texture, seamless three-second repeat, no start or stop. No stone milling discs, electronic hum, tonal drone, music, voices, alarms or cinematic impacts.

candidates.label: B - Damped granular contact
candidates.difference: Same extraction mechanism with softer contact and less high-frequency rasp.
candidates.prompt: Close small-scale mineral extraction: a damped mechanical head works against stone with soft gritty scraping, loose grains shifting and sparse low dull contact sounds. Compact, steady and restrained, less bright rasp, seamless three-second repeat, no start or stop. No electric engine or synthesized drone, quern milling discs, rhythmic hammering, music, speech, beeps or exaggerated rockfalls.
